credits.title: Sônia
credits.overview: Sônia believes that not being young was the predominant factor for her husband's infidelity. In her solitude, she begins a search for self-esteem and self-awareness. For the first time, she allows herself pleasure and confronts internal taboos that had never been awakened before.

credits.title: I Am Going to Miss You
credits.overview: Amanda and Caio are a trans couple who share seven years of love and dreams. However, when they decide to live together, the differences between them begin to take their toll.

credits.title: Bad Girls
credits.overview: In a land far, far away...four actresses were invited to stage a play based on the novel "Bad Girls" by Camila Sosa Villada.

credits.title: Ayô
credits.overview: Ayô is a young, gay, Black actor from Bahia, living in São Paulo, and dissatisfied with his love life. After some emotional disagreements with Manu, Ayô turns to dating apps, where he meets João, with whom he forms an instant connection. credits.title: The Best Mother in the World
credits.overview: To escape her abusive husband, garbage collector Gal packs her two young children, Rihanna and Benin, onto the top of her cart and heads across São Paulo to her cousin’s house. credits.title: Uniformed
credits.overview: A military police officer and a gay man, Gustavo lives two realities that seem irreconcilable. In an environment where wearing the uniform also means being doomed to hide who you are, he feels his true nature crushed by fear. But how long can silence protect you—and when does it become a weapon?

credits.title: The Business Women’s Club
credits.overview: Jongo, a renowned photographer, and Candinho, a young and inexperienced journalist, arrive at a decaying country club of São Paulo's high society, run by women involved with the law.

credits.title: Zero to Hero
credits.overview: When a rock wannabe is forced to replace his famous sertanejo look-alike, he faces a life-changing choice — lose his own identity or follow his heart.

credits.title: Dois + Dois
credits.overview: Diogo and Emília have been together for 16 years. They have a teenage daughter and undergo a tedious phase.
